definitions.explanation: The native Japanese numeral for counting four items, used with the native counting system for general objects.
Used to express the age of four, as in a child being four years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{四|よっ}つ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: There are four glasses on the desk.
This child is four years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四|よっ}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四|よっ}つ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{四|よっ}つ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have a younger brother four years younger.

examples.japanese: {四|よっ}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I've been learning since I was four.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四|よっ}つ⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。

notes:
{四|よっ}つ is part of the native Japanese counting system (⟦ひとつ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧、⟦ふたつ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧、⟦みっつ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧...) used for counting general objects.

NATIVE COUNTING SERIES:
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (1), ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ (2), ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧ (3), {四|よっ}つ (4), ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧ (5)
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧ (6), ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧ (7), ⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧ (8), ⟦{九|ここの}つ→九つ：02902_kokonotsu⟧ (9), ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧ (10)

USAGE NOTES:
- Used when counting general objects without a specific counter
- Also used for ages up to nine (informal)
- {四|よっ}つ is safer than {四|し}つ since {四|し} sounds like ⟦{死|し}→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧ (death)
